shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,280p' src/transport/ws/validation.ts
rg -n \"validateMessage|INVALID_MESSAGE|list_sessions|specs/hal-engine-websocket\" src --glob '*test.ts' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
rg --files scripts/spec-links package.json | sort
sed -n '1,240p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts 2>/dev/null || true
sed -n '1,260p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '1,240p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "find .. -name AGENTS.md -print
sed -n '1,220p' AGENTS.md 2>/dev/null || true
sed -n '1,120p' src/types/conversationListMessages.test.ts
cat package.json | sed -n '1,220p'
sed -n '1,180p' src/types/messages.ts"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,120p' src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts
nl -ba specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md | sed -n '68,82p'
git diff -- src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'npx prettier --write src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts
node scripts/repoint-spec-anchors.mjs origin/main'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git diff --check
git status --short
git diff --stat
git diff -- .lore/dod.md src/transport/ws/validation.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/ws/validation.ts && git commit -m "feat(transport): validate conversation list frames" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main'
